items.name: Line up by rank
items.how: Off the mat. Highest belt in front. Read the roster order if you have one.
say: Line up by rank. Highest belt in front. Ninja stance. Feet together, hands at your sides.

items.name: Bow and come on the mat
items.how: You bow. You step on. You turn and face them. They bow, step on, and rebuild the same line.
say: When we come on the mat, we bow like this.
Bow and come on. Same line. Highest belt in front.

items.name: Names and the plan
items.how: High-five or knuckles down the line. One sentence on what class is today.
say: I'm Teacher {instructor} and this is Teacher {helper}. We're your teachers today.
Are you ready to do jiu-jitsu? I can't hear you.

items.name: Run in circles
items.how: You in front. Easy run around the mat. One direction, then the other. Stay inside the mats.
items.say: Okay everyone follow me and let's run in circles. Stay on the mat!

items.name: Jumping jacks in Portuguese
items.how: Count {reps} jumping jacks out loud in Portuguese. You say the number, they repeat it, then you jump together.
items.say: Jumping jacks! Count with me in Portuguese. Um, dois, três, quatro, cinco, seis, sete, oito, nove, dez!

items.name: Push-ups
items.how: Hands under shoulders. Mighty Mites stay on their knees. Older groups do regular push-ups. {reps} each.
items.say: Push-ups. Down and up. Knees down if you need them. Count with me!

items.name: Sit-ups
items.how: On their back, feet down. Sit up and touch their knees. {reps} each. Hold feet for the little ones.
items.say: Sit-ups. Touch your knees. Down slow. You can do it!

items.name: Bear crawl
items.how: Hands and feet. Hips up. {reps} lengths of the mat.
items.say: Okay stop here! Copy me and do as I do, we're gonna crawl like a bear. Hands and feet.

items.name: Gorilla Walk
items.how: Bent over, hands on the mat or on shins, big stompy steps. {reps} lengths of the mat.
items.say: Okay everyone slow down! We're gonna walk like a Gorilla!

items.name: Jackrabbit
items.how: Fast burst to the far end of the mat and back. Soft feet. {reps} trips. Send them one at a time if the mat is crowded.
items.say: Jackrabbit! Run to the end and back. Fast feet, soft landing. Go!

items.name: Forward roll
items.how: Chin tucked, hands on the mat, roll over one shoulder. Demo slow. {reps} each, in a lane, so nobody rolls into a friend.
items.say: Chin down. Hands here. Watch me roll. Now your turn. One at a time in your lane!

items.name: Backward roll
items.how: Sit, tuck the chin, roll back over a shoulder. Don't land on the neck. Spot Mighty Mites with a hand on the hip. {reps} each.
items.say: Sit. Chin tucked. Roll back over your shoulder. I'll spot you. Don't put your neck on the mat.

items.name: Hip escape (shrimp)
items.how: On their back. One foot on the mat, push the hips away, and turn to the side. That is the shrimp. {reps} to each side.
items.say: On your back. Foot on the mat. Push your hips away. Shrimp! Switch sides.

items.name: Back breakfall
steps: Tuck your chin to your chest so the back of your head never hits the mat.
Sit down close to your heels and round your back.
Slap the mat with both arms at the same time as you land.
items.drill: 3 reps down the lane, then switch lines.
items.safety: Spot Mighty Mites with a hand behind the shoulder. Stop anyone who throws the head back.
items.how: Tuck your chin to your chest so the back of your head never hits the mat. Sit down close to your heels and round your back. Slap the mat with both arms at the same time as you land.
items.say: Tuck your chin to your chest so the back of your head never hits the mat.

items.name: Side breakfall
steps: Tuck the chin and look at your belt.
Fall to one side and slap the mat with that arm.
Knees stay bent. Sit back up and do the other side.
items.drill: 3 reps each side, then switch lines.
items.safety: One lane at a time so nobody falls into a friend.
items.how: Tuck the chin and look at your belt. Fall to one side and slap the mat with that arm. Knees stay bent. Sit back up and do the other side.
items.say: Tuck the chin and look at your belt.

items.name: Technical stand-up
steps: From your back, post one hand on the mat by your ear.
The other foot steps out. Hips up.
Stand tall and bring your hands in front of your face.
items.drill: 5 reps each side, then switch partners so someone can watch the chin.
items.safety: Chin stays tucked. If they hop onto the neck, reset and do it slower.
items.how: From your back, post one hand on the mat by your ear. The other foot steps out. Hips up. Stand tall and bring your hands in front of your face.
items.say: From your back, post one hand on the mat by your ear.

items.name: Dodgeball
items.how: One soft foam ball. Hits below the shoulders only. A hit means five jumping jacks, then they are back in. No head shots and no hard throws. Mighty Mites toss the ball; they don't fire it at faces.
items.say: Soft ball. Below the shoulders. If you get hit, five jumping jacks and you're back in.
items.extra: Play time is earned. Keep the game only if the whole class follows instructions.

games.title: Game
games.note: Play time is earned. The whole class follows instructions, then we play. If they don't, go back to a drill.
